name: Terror of the Desert Skies
summary: A rough drawing shows a great bird of prey that inspired fear and awe. Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale may know more about it.

sections.title: A Fearful Image
sections.body: The Primitive Drawing reaches you with a request to take it to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale. Its broad strokes show a large bird of prey, and the artist's fear and awe are plain in the image. Hemet is asked to judge what it depicts.

faq.answer: The Primitive Drawing depicts a large bird of prey.

faq.q: Who can tell me about the bird?
faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale may be able to tell you more about the creature.

faq.q: Where do I take the drawing?
faq.answer: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
